name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Salta Province of Argentina. The company has delineated a resource of approximately 248 million ounces of contained silver and 2.5 million ounces of contained gold, and is advancing the project toward a final investment decision. AbraSilver has also consolidated its land position around Diablillos with strategic acquisitions to add exploration upside and infrastructure optionality.
